items.title: Why are markets rising today? Sensex up 800 pts intraday, Nifty tops 23,100
items.description: VK Vijayakumar of Geojit Investments, said that the improving earnings growth, fair valuations of large-caps, and strong domestic liquidity are likely supporting the market on declines.

items.title: Stock Market LIVE: Sensex rises 300 pts, Nifty tops 22,950; L&T Tech shares jump 15%
items.description: Sensex Today | Stock Market LIVE Updates Wednesday: In the broader markets, the Nifty MidCap rose 0.02 per cent and the Nifty SmallCap fell 0.09 per cent.

items.title: Nifty IT index hits 10-month high; LTTS zooms 15% on Wednesday; here's why
items.description: Thus far in October, the Nifty IT index has rallied 16% as TCS, Tech Mahindra, Wipro, Infosys and Mphasis surged in the range of 18-23% amid Q2 earnings cheer.

items.title: The great bull-market in India is over; prefer bonds, cash: Marc Faber
items.description: Foreign investors, Faber said, will reduce their exposure to markets around the world. "That is one reason I am reasonably positive about the US dollar," he added.

items.title: HD Fire Protect lists at 24% premium over IPO price after 132x subscription
items.description: On the BSE, the stock listed at ₹334, a premium of 23.39 per cent, while on the NSE, the stock made its debut at ₹335, a premium of 23.62 per cent.

items.title: Hind Zinc up 4% post Q2; analysts see silver prices key to earnings growth
items.description: Jefferies said that Hindustan Zinc trades below the long-term average EV/Ebitda and that recovery in silver price would be key for stock performance.

items.title: Bajaj Finance down 3% post Q2; analysts stay bullish on asset quality gains
items.description: Bajaj Finance reported a 29 per cent year-on-year (YoY) rise in consolidated net profit to ₹6,367 crore for the July-September quarter of FY27.

items.title: Asian shares climb, bonds stabilise as strong earnings buoy Wall Street
items.description: MSCI's broadest index of Asia-Pacific shares outside Japan was up 1.5%, led by ​a 4% gain for Korean shares, while Japan's Nikkei 225 climbed 1.3%

items.title: Stocks to watch: Eternal, Hindustan Zinc, YES Bank, Bajaj Fin, IREDA, LTTS
items.description: Stocks to watch: Eternal, Hindustan Zinc, YES Bank, Bajaj Finance, IREDA, LTTS, RailTel Corporation, Adani Green Energy, Indian Hotels Company, KEI Industries, among others, will be in action today.

items.title: Here's why Shrikant Chouhan of Kotak Neo is bullish on JSW Steel, Groww
items.description: The structural earnings outlook for JSW Steel remains positive given it's focus on cost optimization, captive raw material integration, and scale expansion, says Shrikant Chouhan of Kotak Neo.

items.title: Consumer durables demand mixed; prefer LG, Polycab India: Motilal Oswal
items.description: After a slow start during Ganesh Chaturthi, demand picked up in Navratri, with consumer durables sales growing 25-30% YoY, notes Motilal Oswal Wealth Management Research Desk.

items.title: NCC, J&K Bank, VRL Logistics top stock picks by Anand James of Geojit
items.description: Anand James, Chief Market Strategist, Geojit Investments explains that NCC is showing early signs of a recovery, with the stock breaking above its declining trendline on charts.
